Quire EPUB Reader: Privacy Policy

Last updated: 10 October 2026

Quire does not collect, transmit, sell or share any personal data.

  • No accounts, analytics, ads or tracking. Quire contains no analytics or telemetry code.
  • Your books stay on your computer. EPUB files you open, plus your library, reading positions, bookmarks and settings, are stored only in your browser (IndexedDB and chrome.storage.local). They are never sent anywhere.
  • Network access. The only network request Quire makes is to download the EPUB file you chose to open, from the site that hosts it.
  • Web pages. Quire has no content scripts and does not read or change the pages you visit. It only redirects navigations to EPUB files into its own reader page.
  • Removing data. Removing a book from the library deletes it. Uninstalling Quire deletes all its stored data.

Questions or problems: open an issue at https://github.com/dzoba/quire-epub-reader/issues
